title: Console host prerequisites
responsibility: Checks console-install prerequisites and reports dependency or bundled-size warnings without installing files.

inputs.name: installableHost.options
inputs.description: Options passed to the console host prerequisite check. The host must contain svelte.config.js or svelte.config.ts and src/routes; base must be one lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen path segment, update and keep cannot both be true, bucket must be a binding name, prefix must be a plain bucket path and requires bucket, and policy must start with $lib/ and resolve to a supported module under src/lib that exports policyExport.

inputs.name: hostWarnings.host
inputs.description: Host directory used to read package.json while checking whether @dafuga01/harness is a dependency. A missing or unreadable package.json is treated as an empty object.

inputs.name: hostWarnings.compressedBytes
inputs.description: Compressed bundled-history size in bytes. A size warning is added only when the value is greater than 3 MiB.

outputs.name: installableHost
outputs.description: Resolves with undefined after validating the SvelteKit host, base, option combination, storage names, and policy module/export; it reads files but writes no installation files. It rejects with ExpectedCliError when a prerequisite check fails.

outputs.name: hostWarnings
outputs.description: Resolves to zero or more warning strings: one when neither dependencies nor devDependencies contains @dafuga01/harness, and one when compressedBytes exceeds 3 MiB; the size warning states the 3 MiB free-plan and 10 MiB paid-plan limits. Invalid JSON or invalid dependency-map values in package.json can reject the promise.
examples: @dafuga01/harness is not a dependency of the host yet; add it before building.
The bundled history is 4.5 MiB compressed; a Worker script may be 3 MiB on the free plan and 10 MiB on a paid one. Keep it in a private bucket with --bucket <binding>.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the host lacks the required SvelteKit files, base or storage options are invalid, update and keep are both selected, or the policy path/module/export check fails.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejected by JSON.parse when a readable package.json contains invalid JSON.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejected when parsed package.json is null or dependencies/devDependencies is a null or primitive value used by destructuring or the in operator without validation.
